verdict.rationale: A cloud platform with agent offerings, such as the Select AI Agent Framework and OCI Generative AI, could plausibly consume external MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows OCI connecting to or plugging in MCP servers as a client. The official MCP server at github.com/oracle/mcp covers the server role, a different story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
